routes.contract: pending secret is preserved on retry; enabled users refuse; a new pending secret is conditional on no existing pending secret; no secret is stored in audit/receipt
TOTP + factor revision/step conditional update; recovery codes delivered once; same-operation retry returns already_applied without codes; same id different material conflicts
TOTP + revision/step conditional update clears factor and code rows; stale/replayed writer refuses; same-operation retry is already_applied
one conditional consumption per code; concurrent/replayed use matches zero rows; same-operation retry is already_applied; legacy plaintext codes are backfilled once; unverified auth grant returns 503

actor tenant/workspace/target/required-role authorization; exact-scope conditional HITL claim; pending/rejected/foreign/stale/missing never release; durable resolver readback; unverified approval returns 503 with action/operation identity

durable_models.auth_2fa_backup_codes: one keyed-fingerprint row per recovery code; consumed_at is the single-use arbiter
durable_models.auth_2fa_operations: safe operation receipt bound to user/scope/action/target/revision/material fingerprint; no raw secrets/codes
durable_models.HITLAction: existing reviewed_by/reviewed_at columns now persisted by the conditional claim

response_contract.verified_paths: existing success/error shapes preserved; additive verification/operation_id/audit_id metadata
response_contract.state_change_audit_unavailable: HTTP 200 with verification.status=unavailable and replay=do_not_repeat for setup/enable/disable
response_contract.auth_grant_unverified: HTTP 503 with identity and replay=do_not_repeat for backup verify/action approval
response_contract.lost_confirmation: effect_unknown with operation/action identity; never a clean refusal

not_covered: login, password reset/change, SSO, passkeys, mobile biometric, provider disconnect
